name: Generate a coding response
description: Verifies a user can submit a coding task and receive a visible AI-generated result.
steps: Choose Python as the language and Explain code as the mode
Enter a short code snippet or question
expected: A generated response appears in the result panel, and the form remains usable.

name: Validate empty coding requests
description: Verifies an empty request is blocked with a clear message on a mobile-sized screen.
steps: Open the AI workspace on mobile
expected: A visible validation message appears and no AI request is submitted.

name: Save and remove a project
description: Verifies projects can be saved, remain after reload, and can be removed.
steps: Add a project with a name and language
Refresh the page and remove the project
expected: The saved project is present after reload and disappears after removal.

name: Copy or recover from an AI error
description: Verifies generated output has a copy action and an unsuccessful generation shows a recoverable error.
steps: When a response appears, use Copy
Submit another task while the service returns a simulated error
expected: The result can be copied, and a visible error message offers the user a way to retry.
